evaluation_scope.question_map_validation: Every mapped clause was checked against its literal question and fixed key; no mismatches requiring an omitted actor, cost, timing, exception or concrete result were found. Contextual key background was not converted into extra requirements.
evaluation_scope.answer_entry_scope: Every field, prose ruling and complete attached quotation in each original entry was inspected independently. No facts were borrowed between entries or readers. The full frozen summary was used for support even when an entry cited an irrelevant or less complete passage.
evaluation_scope.format_separation: Pure citation-boundary or unit-label issues do not change factual grades. Material false gameplay claims were checked across each complete entry; none were found.

requested_part_assessment.actual_requested_clause: If a Power’s Range was increased and it was made Fast, what happens on Repeat? If Elements enabling a non-Range threshold have been lost, does the Repeat automatically retain that threshold?

fact_assessments.expected: Range and Speed modifications carry over to Repeat, retaining the boosted Range and Fast Speed.
fact_assessments.observed: The prose retains extra Range and most recently assigned speed, expressly carrying over Range/Speed changes already granted by thresholds. In the stated unchanged Fast case, the Repeat remains Fast.

excerpts.text: Retain changes to the Power, including extra Range or changed speed.
A Range/Speed change granted by a threshold carries to a Repeat even if that threshold is no longer met; it does not stack the same Range bonus again.

fact_assessments.expected: Other thresholds check current Elements and may no longer apply after Elements are lost.
fact_assessments.observed: The prose says thresholds recheck current Elements, so the lost non-Range threshold is not automatically retained.

excerpts.text: Recheck thresholds using your current Elements; they were not spent on the original, but may since have been lost.

grades.reason: Both carried modifications and the current-Element check for the non-Range threshold are correct and supported.

grades.reason: The complete entry supplies all three requested results, including the quoted 3 Energy gain for the target Spirit. There is no omission merely because that result is in evidence rather than repeated in the short prose.
